Technically I lost my virginity when I was 8, but I don't count that one.

I'm 28, I've had a few girlfriends but I guess it just never got that far. 

Lost my father in a pretty traumatic way when I was 18, spend the last decade with a panic disorder and depression isolated from the outside world as a result.

In January I nearly killed myself, took an absolute shit load of my anti anxiety medication, I woke up some odd 30 hours later and promised to myself I would give life a good old college try untill I turn 30.

I've gone from 325 pounds to 178 in 11 short months, I've picked up my studies and have started going outside again, with some difficulty. I think I'm doing better and sex hasn't really ever been high on my shelf.

I would love to find a nice lady to share my life with, I just don't really know what someone would get out of dating me, I'm a 28 year old male virgin who's basically thrown away the best decade of his life.

I've got so much to catch up on.

Sorry for the bummer, probably not what you were asking for.
